text.comment: Ah, there you are!
I am afraid the results of my research have turned out inconclusive.
This so-called Protectyon is a condensate substance unlike anything else I have ever encountered.
This sample is highly instable and incredibly potent, and I am afraid that I just do not have the instruments to adequately examine it further.

It certainly will not be possible to synthesise the condensate with any equipment we currently have at our disposal, and, as difficult as it is for me to admit, I doubt that anyone else in the network is in possession of the technology to do so, either.
How very odd. Northriver is a remarkably small company that seems to have just shot up out of nowhere roughly eleven years ago.
If what you say is true then they could not possibly had the means to develop this themselves.
And frankly, while Brantlee is undoubtedly an ambitious businessman, he certainly does not strike me as the... scientific type.
Oh dear, speaking of - I have just received a communications request from Brantlee Northriver. Opening comms channel.
So, how is it going? Have you cracked it yet?
Of course you haven't!
As if I, corporate mastermind inventor, would risk giving away my secrets.
That petty jerk really just got into contact to gloat.
Perhaps you can use the occasion to extract some information...
His ego is his weakness. Try to bait him into giving something away!
Well, of course I can be proud of my accomplishments. I built this company from the ground up! I came from nothing!
Hard work and dedication, that's all it takes.
And now our Northriver product keeps an entire system of people safe!
This is clearly not working.
He is too preoccupied with praising himself to actually betray anything of substance.
I know! From what we know he is immensely proud of his ship...
Just go with that, that might lead somewhere!
Ah, it's not the equipment, it's the minds that make all the difference.
You and your fish friend just cannot match my scientific acumen!
Strip it all away from me, shut down my company and through sheer dedication and wit I would still rise to the top again.
This is clearly not working.
He is too preoccupied with praising himself to actually betray anything of substance.
I know! From what we know he is immensely proud of his ship...
Just go with that, that might lead somewhere!
A race, huh? Let me think about it...
Alright, I don't know why you would want to challenge me, seeing as the Astrid is literally the fastest ship out there, but sure, let's go for it!
And you know what? I'll do you one better!
You have been trying so pathetically to assay the Protectyion, so if you win I will just tell you what you want to know about it.
But you wont!
Bring your fastest ship! I am looking forward to this.

text.comment: He is right, you know.
As much as it pains me to admit, looking at his ship's specifications I predict a 0.0003% chance of you emerging from this race as the victor.
And these odds already factor in the chance of a spontaneous unforeseen organ failure on his part.
Considering what is at stake here no one would think worse of you were you to bend the rules a little in your favour.

text.comment: So you came? Wise choice!
This one has a good business sense, I can tell...
Yes, and we will get to that.
Now, if you don't mind me asking, how did you find this place?
Ah, yes. I knew that our efforts to clean up should have been more thorough.
It seems our contacts in the Vigor Syndicate are slipping.
I paid them an obscene amount of credits to make you go away, and look where that has left us!
Yes, well, clearly that did not work, so how about we approach this from a different angle, hm?
As you probably figured out, this here is our very own golden goose.
We have no idea what this whole construct is about, but we did figure out that we can use the condensate surrounding it as shielding against the Tide.
We are in a very unique position.
The people of Avarice absolutely need it. Only we can provide it.
Are you able to follow along so far?
Oh please... don't be naive!
Because we can, of course!
As far as we can tell the reserves here could supply the entire galaxy for centuries, and we would not run out.
This stuff is highly potent, highly advanced.
But who'd be willing to repeatedly pay us obscene amounts of money if they knew that?
Sheer luck, like you wouldn't believe it.
I was just returning from a trade run in my ship when the Tide hit my ship and pushed it into the anomaly.
I don't know exactly why, but I could immediately tell this system was different.
Put that down to my entrepreneurial spirit, huh?
Anyway, my ship was pretty badly damaged from the impact, so it took me a while to get everything back into shape.
Once it was operational again, I eventually came across the derelict station and the Protectyon.
Someone else must have come before us, though. I was able to interface with technology that was very similar to ours to access the Protectyon.
I suspect it was those nomad researchers.

It took us a while to figure out how to properly transport and store this stuff, but from there on out it was just failing upwards and knowing which people to pay, both to figure out the product at hand and to make any troublemakers disappear.
Good, then you probably know where we are heading with this.
Now, obviously we need you to keep quiet about this.
We could try and kill you, but as you might have noticed we are not thugs, and our ships are certainly not made to shoot at anyone.
I mean, sure, we could sic the Vigor Syndicate on you again, throw waves and waves of hired gunmen at you until you are dead - and you would die, eventually!
But why should we? It is costly and unpredictable.
And by the time you are permantently done for, knowledge of this place might have spread throughout the entire universe and we cannot risk that.
Yes, so how about we offer you an unofficial position in this enterprise?
You are here now. That means clearly the Vigor Syndicate leadership is slipping.
You could be the change of management we have been looking for.
Of course, we would pay you. Handsomely!
And who knows, if we get along well, we might even allow you to buy an Astrid-class ship of your own...
You know what?
Think about it!
Take a look around this ship!
Make sure to really take in all the luxurious details!
The exquisite wood panelling - that is authentic wood, by the way, none of that synthetic rubbish - and the marble flooring!
Really think about what your next steps will look like. You could rise to the top with us!
When you have made up your mind, speak with us again, and we will set everything in motion!

text.comment: This ship sure is something, is it not?
Oh, the magnificent opulence of it all!
That'll make anyone want to keep their mouth shut, right?
We deserve to be on the top, and with all good work so far, clearly you deserve to be rewarded, too.
What do you say - are you in?
(Energetic)Accessing blueprint now!
What... Who are you talking to?
So does that mean you refuse to fall in line?!
Blueprint added to your database.
Brother, something is wrong!
It appears the blueprints to our Protectyon storage facility have just been stolen!
You! How dare you?!
We will make sure to make your life a living hell, no matter the cost!
And we have deep pockets!
Hold on, what?!
(#nod01#)Very well.
We can't say it surprises us, seeing what we have to offer, but we are relieved nontheless.
I will transfer the payment of credits momentarily, as agreed.
As I mentioned before, we are looking to replace the Vigor Syndicate as our right hand.
We will get in touch again shortly!
This is incredible. How could you betray the people of Avarice like that?
How dare you?! I thought you a dear friend!
We made profits together! You saved my life...

text.comment: What do you...?
Oh... it's you! I would not have thought you brave enough to return to our territory.
Or perhaps it is not bravery... Stupidity?
No, clearly you did not get to this point by being stupid.
I don't much care what it is you did to the Northriver Company suits, but it must have been good.
Hello? Who is this?
Ah, so you want to pay us to back off?
Very well, I will relay the message, and your credits.
(Frustrated)Do not waste my time again!

text.comment: Ah, yes, there you are!
I am glad that you have returned before I left, I would have hated to part ways without saying goodbye properly.
And, of course, to thank you!
Turning down the twins' offer must not have been easy; it certainly was a lucrative deal!
Truly, I cannot say how I would have acted if I was in your situation, which makes me appreciate your decision even more.
Thank you for everything you have done for the people of Avarice, and for me personally!
Now it is time for me to return home, and to seek my fortune in between the abandoned wreckage once more.
Just now with a bit of added perspective.
Amassing wealth at the detriment of all else might not be quite as admirable as I once thought.
Take care, and may lots of profits await you in the times to come!
How could you?!(disappointed)
Greetings, friend!
Good profits to you!
(10/10)Take care, and may many profits await you in the times to come!

text.comment: You want to buy another Astrid?
No way, this is a highly exclusive item we are talking about here! We won't just mass produce her like that!
Are you here to buy an Astrid-class ship?
I have just commissioned the closest wharf! I will be in touch to facilitate the transfer.
Come back any time.
